marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure Investment
marketLayer.fact: Leading US tech giants reported rising Q2 capital expenditure aimed at AI datacenter expansion and custom semiconductor development.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained hardware spending continues to support semiconductor design and equipment manufacturers, though immediate software margins face pressure.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Enterprise AI monetization pace and potential short-term hardware overcapacity.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong High-Dividend Shares & Southbound Capital
marketLayer.fact: Southbound Stock Connect recorded persistent net inflows targeting Chinese state-owned telecommunications and energy sector equities.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland capital prefers high-yield, defensive assets in Hong Kong to mitigate broader market volatility and yield pressures.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of mainland consumer sentiment recovery and US dollar liquidity shifts.

marketLayer.title: US Inflation Trends & Federal Reserve Policy Trajectory
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation and labor indicators showed mild cooling, reinforcing market expectations for monetary easing in upcoming FOMC meetings.
marketLayer.inference: Easing Treasury yields are expected to support valuation multiples for high-growth sectors and lower global borrowing costs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky services inflation and macroeconomic spillover from trade policy developments.
